name: Tamikan AP OLD
savenote: +1 Status to All Saves vs. Magic

defensiveAbilities.name: Attack of Opportunity (Tail Only)
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Boat Breaker
offensiveAbilities.description: A kongamato's beak is supernaturally hard. Their beak Strikes ignore half the Hardness of any object they hit.

offensiveAbilities.name: Flying Strafe
offensiveAbilities.description: The kongamato Flies up to their fly Speed and makes two wing Strikes at any point during that movement. Each Strike must target a different creature.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sonic Screech
offensiveAbilities.description: Tamikan unleashes a powerful and deadly blast of sonic force from her maw that deals 12d6 Sonic Damage damage in a 100ft Line (Basic DC 37 Reflex Saving Throw save). She can't use Sonic Screech again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Wailing Dive
offensiveAbilities.description:
The kongamato Flies while emitting a terrifying screech. Each creature the kongamato flies over must succeed at a DC 37 Will Saving Throw save or become Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure).

After attempting their saves, the creatures are temporarily immune for 1 hour. At the end of their movement, the kongamato can make a beak Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
